title: False positives vs. training size
description: Data-scaling test runs: seeds 42/43/44, final checkpoints, training sizes 5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 320, 625, noise floor 0.03% of image area. Seeds vary initialization only; training subsets are nested. Uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 15 normal test cases (10,000 replicates, RNG seed 0), applied to the seed-mean FP rate. Case resamples are shared across seeds and sizes.
ci_method: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 15 normal test cases (10,000 replicates, RNG seed 0), applied to the seed-mean FP rate. Case resamples are shared across seeds and sizes.
exact_ci_method: 95% exact binomial (Clopper-Pearson) interval for each seed's k/15. Conservative by construction; recommended at low counts, where the bootstrap interval tends to be too narrow.

lesion_level.label: No-overlap FP regions per image
lesion_level.definition: Retained predicted region with no pixel overlap with the ground-truth mass; every retained region on a normal image counts.
lesion_level.ci_method: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 110 test images (10,000 replicates, RNG seed 0), applied to the seed-mean FP regions per image.

criterion_fp_regions.label: Criterion-specific FP regions per image
criterion_fp_regions.definition: Retained component count minus one if the criterion detects the mass on a mass image, otherwise all retained components; on normal images all retained components count. Averaged over all test images.
criterion_fp_regions.ci_method: 95% percentile bootstrap over the 110 test images (10,000 replicates, RNG seed 0), applied to the seed-mean FP regions per image. Image resamples are shared across seeds and sizes.
